preconditions.description: The number of destinations n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of Time Corridors m must be between n-1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor must connect two distinct destinations within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: The energy e of each corridor must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(set((a, b) for a, b, e in corridors)) == m
preconditions.description: All pairs of destinations must be unique.

postconditions.description: The output must contain m-(n-1) lines, each representing E_{max}(c_i) for non-MST corridors.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(e_max, int) and 0 <= e_max <= 10**9 for e_max in output)
postconditions.description: Each E_{max}(c_i) must be an integer within the range of 0 to 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(e_max <= e for e_max, e in zip(output, [e for a, b, e in corridors if (a, b) not in mst_edges]))
postconditions.description: Each E_{max}(c_i) must be less than or equal to the original energy of the corresponding corridor.
